name: loopgrid
description: Verifiable Claude Code decision evidence: six MCP tools and optional opt-in Pre/Post tool hooks send tool names, hashed inputs/results and numeric policy fields to your configured LoopGrid Core for policy gating and signed verification.

core_url.title: LoopGrid Core URL
core_url.description: Optional HTTPS LoopGrid Core origin, or http://127.0.0.1:8000 for a local Core; leave blank to use LOOPGRID_BASE_URL.

workspace_id.title: LoopGrid workspace ID
workspace_id.description: Optional workspace ID for evidence and policy. Leave blank to use LOOPGRID_WORKSPACE or default.

service_key.title: LoopGrid service key
service_key.description: Optional Core API service key, stored in Claude secure configuration. Not needed for a local unauthenticated Core.
